breach.name: LimeLeads
breach.title: LimeLeads
breach.summary: In 2019, the now-defunct B2B marketing leads database service LimeLeads suffered a data breach due to an exposed, unsecured Elasticsearch server. The incident exposed tens of millions of records of largely corporate contact data containing 17.8M unique email addresses, along with phone numbers, employers, job titles and geographic locations including state, city and postcode.

background: In 2019, the now-defunct B2B marketing leads database service LimeLeads suffered a data breach due to an exposed, unsecured Elasticsearch server. The incident exposed tens of millions of records of largely corporate contact data containing 17.8M unique email addresses, along with phone numbers, employers, job titles and geographic locations including state, city and postcode.
how: In 2019, the now-defunct B2B marketing leads database service LimeLeads suffered a data breach due to an exposed, unsecured Elasticsearch server.
outcome: 17,838,396 accounts are listed in this breach. This is a count of accounts, not necessarily individual people.
The reported exposed data includes Email addresses, Employers, Geographic locations, Job titles, Phone numbers.

fields.name: Phone numbers
fields.why: Enables SIM-swap attacks against SMS two-factor codes, and puts the number on scam-call lists indefinitely.

fields.name: Geographic locations
fields.why: Where the account was used, which narrows a person down further than most people expect.

fields.name: Employers
fields.why: Connects a personal account to a workplace, which is how attackers pivot from a person to a company.

fields.name: Email addresses
fields.why: An exposed address may be used in phishing attempts. Treat unexpected messages with caution.

fields.name: Job titles
fields.why: Identifies who has access to what, which is how targets for business email compromise are picked.

actions: Move two-factor authentication off SMS and onto an authenticator app, which a SIM swap cannot intercept.
Be alert to phishing. A message may use details from exposed or collected records to appear familiar; verify requests through the service directly.
breach.scale_line: That is about 66% of the population of Australia.
